description: External comparator for the modelled 2030 constraint cost (a cited constant for the explorer's trust panel and the bill notebook). Not an input to any bill line.

neso_cp30_ffr_thermal.scope: thermal constraints only; one year on 2013 weather; the recommended CP30 network; interconnector counter-trades are inside the figure
neso_cp30_ffr_thermal.source_label: NESO, Clean Power 2030: Advice on achieving clean power for Great Britain by 2030 (5 Nov 2024), main report, Table 1, p.36
neso_cp30_ffr_thermal.like_for_like_model_measure: balancing_costs.constraint_cost_gbp (accepted offers and bids, net of slack and penalty-priced turn-down) plus annual_aggregate.interconnector_retrading_cost_GBP, in CP30_2030_cp30_network_consumer_bill_future_summary.json
neso_cp30_ffr_thermal.price_basis_note: The model is in real 2025 money; restating NESO to 2025 prices widens any gap by the 2024-25 inflation step.

neso_cp30_ffr_thermal_voltage_stability.scope: thermal plus voltage and stability constraints
